parts.t: Neighbourhood guide · City of Chilliwack · Rosedale
Rosedale is a rural community along Yale Road and an MLS® sub-area name in the City of Chilliwack. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.

The closest official description is in the City’s 2040 Official Community Plan, which listed Rosedale as a Rural Settlement, with Greendale and Yarrow. Its development limits are defined by the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), and the plan carried a land use map for it, Map 17D.
Rosedale Traditional Community School and Rosedale Park both sit on Yale Road.

Planning, zoning and flood

blocks.text: Planning and flood notes for Rosedale

parts.t: Plans, zoning and flood rules can be different for each lot.

The 2050 Official Community Plan, Official Community Plan Bylaw 2025, No. 5500, was adopted on December 16, 2025. Rosedale is covered by its city-wide land use framework and by Schedule B1, the Agricultural Area Plan.
The 2040 Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 4025, adopted in 2014, carried the Rosedale land use map (Map 17D) and the Rural Settlement policies. The 2050 plan replaced it.
The 2040 plan’s policy was to retain the Rural Settlement boundaries of Greendale, Rosedale and Yarrow and limit future growth to existing development areas.
The Agricultural Area Plan was carried forward as Schedule B1 of the 2050 plan.
ALR: Rosedale’s development limits are defined by the ALR, and ALR status is set parcel by parcel.

City floodplain mapping is based on the Province’s Fraser River flood levels from the 1894 flood of record, which the City describes as roughly a 1-in-500-year flood. The City updated its floodplain maps in 2007. The City also runs an ongoing dyke-raising program of about $30 million. Property-level floodplain status must be checked address by address on the City maps.
Published municipal directories do not list a flood or slope document specific to Rosedale beyond the City-wide floodplain material.

Where is Rosedale?
Rosedale is a rural community along Yale Road and an MLS® sub-area name. The City doesn’t publish a boundary for it.
The closest official description is the 2040 Official Community Plan, which listed it as a Rural Settlement with development limits defined by the ALR.
Ask me if a specific address is in it.
How do I get around from Rosedale?
BC Transit route 71 Agassiz–Harrison runs between Downtown Chilliwack and Harrison Hot Springs and stops in Rosedale at Yale Rd at McGrath Rd and Yale Rd at Hwy 9.
No additional BC Transit route serving Rosedale.

route 71 page
Which school is in Rosedale?
Rosedale Traditional Community School (kindergarten to grade 8) is at 50850 Yale Rd.
Published municipal directories do not list a second public school in Rosedale. Check an exact address with the
SD33 School Locator
What parks and library are near Rosedale?
Rosedale Park is at 51535 Yale Rd and has a skateboard facility.
Cheam Lake Wetlands Regional Park (53480 Elgey Road) is an FVRD park of 107 hectares with a floating boardwalk, about 2 km of trails and no pets allowed.
There is no library branch in Rosedale.
What plan covers Rosedale?
The 2050 Official Community Plan, adopted on December 16, 2025, and its Schedule B1, the Agricultural Area Plan.
The 2040 plan carried a Rosedale land use map (Map 17D) and the Rural Settlement policies.
Is Rosedale in a floodplain?

City floodplain mapping is based on the Province’s Fraser River flood levels from the 1894 flood of record, which the City describes as roughly a 1-in-500-year flood. The City updated its floodplain maps in 2007. The City runs an ongoing dyke-raising program of about $30 million.
Property-level floodplain status needs an address check on the City maps. Ask me or the City about a specific lot.
Is Rosedale in the ALR, and what are the lots like?
Rosedale’s development limits are defined by the ALR, and all ALR parcels remain designated Agricultural.
